'''Shrandhnrignh''', or '''Sandi''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Sandi lived in the city of [[Gadrin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where she owned and ran the tea bar [[Stardust (tea bar)|Stardust]]. She knew the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Selima DeWitt]].
